text:
Aisha (cs_lead): Quick weekly pulse for Solara — seeing a token surge during onboarding flows and throughput wobble. 95p latency is ~20% WoW up; error rate for gpt-serve endpoints creeping from 0.6% -> 1.2%. Spend is trending about +28% WoW vs. their commit. Can infra/eng confirm whether this is traffic pattern or a perf regression? Also flagging potential renewal risk if spend churn continues.

Marco (infra): Looking now. Early signals show concentrated bursts from session creation endpoint around 03:20–03:50 UTC daily. Not seeing model-level OOMs, but GPU queue depth spiked. Putting a short trace link: https://go.redwood/trace/solara/3618 — will paste metric snap.

usage-bot: Alert: account=solara | tokens=1.9M (WoW +42%) | spend=$6.8k (WoW +28%) | threshold(commit)=$5k.

Marco (infra): Metric snippet: ```
window,start,end,tokens,95p_latency_ms,error_rate
2026-03-16,03:00,04:00,210000,92,0.6%
2026-03-23,03:00,04:00,299000,110,1.2%
2026-03-30,03:00,04:00,420000,132,1.1%
``` Looks like ramp + higher tail latency. The 03:20 spike aligns with their nightly batch job creating thousands of short-lived chat sessions.

Elena (enablement): Noted — Solara said they ran an A/B migration to add longer system prompts last week. That can multiply token usage if prompts are prepended per request. Jin, did the customer share the prompt sizes?

Jin (acct_mgr): They sent an email yesterday — average system prompt went from ~120 tokens -> ~420 tokens for the new personalization step. I'll forward the thread. Their renewal conversation is scheduled in 3 weeks; they're on a $60k/yr commitment but usage already > 12% of remaining in month. Risk: medium-high if we can't show cost controls.

Aisha (cs_lead): Good context. Action items: 1) Marco, can infra propose a quick mitigation (prefix cache or batch window tweak) to bring 95p down 15%? 2) Elena, schedule a 30m enablement session with Solara to review prompt strategy and tokenizing — aim this week. 3) Jin, prepare risk note for renewal team with current spend trajectory and suggested credits/ops.

Marco (infra): Proposed short-term patch: enable prefix (KV) caching for their session namespace + reduce GPU bin size for short sequences. Estimated improvement: 12–18% 95p reduction, and token compute drop ~10%. I'll open a canary config at 04:30 UTC and monitor.

Elena (enablement): I have an available slot Friday 16:00 UTC. I can show them how to deduplicate system prompts, use dynamic context trimming, and move repeated metadata into a single session initialization call. Share a sample guide.

Jin (acct_mgr): Forwarded the prompt samples to Aisha and Elena. Also asked Solara if the nightly job can be spread out — they said not without refactoring but open to short-term throttle. Will surface options in renewal prep doc.

Aisha (cs_lead): Thanks. Also, please note the error rate bump appears mostly 500-level user-facing errors from the chat ingestion service. Marco, can you link any traces or logs for the ops ticket?

Marco (infra): Yea — created OPS-6342 and attached logs. Key log excerpt: ```
[03:22:41] chat-ingest ERROR: write timeout to kvcache (ns=solara_sessions) after 250ms
[03:22:41] chat-ingest WARN: retrying request id=abc123
[03:22:44] gateway ERROR: upstream rate limit hit, status=429
``` Looks like brief kvcache contention followed by backpressure.

usage-bot: Note: projected month-end spend at current run rate = $27.4k (commit burn 46%).

Aisha (cs_lead): OK — stitch these into the renewal risk note. I'll escalate to enterprise solutions if we need a one-time offset. For now: Marco, roll the canary and post 95p/err metrics in this thread once stable. Elena, confirm Friday 16:00 slot with Solara and drop calendar invite. Jin, draft renewal note and include the mitigation timeline + cost projection.

Elena (enablement): Invite sent to their eng lead and product manager. Agenda: 1) prompt sizing review 2) session init patterns 3) memo on token-saving quick wins.

Marco (infra): Canary live at 04:30 UTC — initial readouts: 95p_latency = 118ms (vs 132), error_rate = 0.9%. Will monitor over next 12h and report back.

Jin (acct_mgr): Drafted renewal risk note and uploaded to shared drive: https://go.redwood/docs/solara-renewal-draft — includes spend scenarios (conservative/likely/worst).

Aisha (cs_lead): Perfect. We'll reconvene same time next week unless we need to update sooner. Closing loop: primary risk=spend overrun from prompt change; mitigations = caching + enablement + schedule smoothing. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
